notes: Campuses: Potchefstroom, Vanderbijlpark. Also needs a Home Language and a First Additional Language at level 4. Mathematics or Technical Mathematics at least 50%. Conditional entry (must pass bridging modules MTEC 111 and MTEC 121 in the first two years) for: Maths at least 40%; OR Maths Lit at least 60% plus at least 40% in a Technology subject; OR Technical Maths at least 40%.
